# The Cocktail Clinic (เดอะ ค็อกเทล คลินิก)

> Doctor-led medical and aesthetic clinic on the 3rd floor of Wannasorn Tower, Phaya Thai Road, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand, near BTS Phaya Thai Exit 4 and the Phaya Thai Airport Rail Link. Website: https://www.thecocktail-clinic.com

The clinic is led by Dr. Manavee Prommas (Dr. Kony; พญ. มาณวี พรหมมาศ, หมอกร). Open daily 11:00–20:00. One hour of parking in the building is listed at no charge.

Medical advice on this site is written by the clinic's doctors. This file is a map of public pages, not medical advice.

## Languages

Thai is the default and has no URL prefix. English, Chinese (Simplified), and Japanese use prefixes:

- Thai: https://www.thecocktail-clinic.com/
- English: https://www.thecocktail-clinic.com/en/
- Chinese: https://www.thecocktail-clinic.com/zh/
- Japanese: https://www.thecocktail-clinic.com/ja/
